title: The webinar
hook: Setty, in bed, to the coach at his desk: You did your [bleep]ing webinar, right?
cta: Comment SETTY (he sends everything to build your AI setter for free)
caption:
Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free. Follow so the DM lands 📩

👇 READ BELOW: what happens after your webinar, and what Setty does about it.

1. The webinar ends and your DMs fill up with "how much?" and "is the replay still up?".

2. You answer the price, and some of them vanish for good.

3. Setty, the AI setter I built for coaches who sell in the DMs, learns your offer and talks like you.

4. He waits until they're done typing, asks one question at a time and only sends your calendar to the serious ones.

The catch: Setty can't promise you a number of calls, and when a lead asks something your offer doesn't cover, he hands the chat back to you.

Comment "SETTY" and he'll send you everything to build your AI setter for free.
